purpose: Visible, versioned source of approved backend policy values. Documentation and planned configuration reference this record; it is not runtime configuration or a deployed setting.

versions.expiry_expression: qualifying_membership_verified_at + 3600 seconds, or an earlier applicable authority expiry
versions.scope: Each previously verified user's affected Sleeper league access; never L1 sign-in or account lifecycle
semantics: Every allow decision is bounded by this age, including when an old positive observation remains selected and no newer failure has been recorded.
Unknown first-time membership does not grant access.
A successful qualified network verification can advance membership verification time; failure, unknown/partial unqualified coverage, cache reads, replay and outage onset cannot reset the clock.
Complete confirmed loss of all qualifying roles ends affected league access as soon as accepted/detected, without waiting for the 60-minute bound.
At the expiry timestamp suspend affected league-data serving until qualifying verification returns; expiry is not a recorded membership removal.
L1 login/account access and other eligible leagues remain available independently; do not delete shared league records.
Connection end and actual permission revocation remain independent deny conditions. Outage grace cannot override them.
acceptance_requirements: Positive role verified at T can qualify access before T+3600 only while other dependencies remain valid.
At T+3600, no fresh qualifying evidence means affected league serving expires; no automatic clock extension.
Complete confirmed removal accepted before expiry denies immediately.
L1 sign-in and other eligible leagues survive outage, expiry and removal.
Version change recomputes access validity from qualifying evidence under the explicit approved version, with no stale cached-policy bypass.

change_process: Record an explicit approved replacement value and reason as a new immutable policy version; retain prior versions and human decision evidence.
Move current_approved_version only after the new decision is recorded; do not rewrite the previous version or approval quote.
Update readable summaries and implementation configuration references together, with structural consistency checks.
Implement, test and deploy the chosen version through the normal authorized release path; document approval alone never changes runtime.
Preserve a separate deployment record/version so approved policy and deployed policy are never conflated.
not_approved_by_this_decision: Watched/background refresh cadences, retry intervals, rate budgets and scheduling limits remain engineering proposals.
The percentile definition and measurement method for approximately 60-second additional score delay remain proposals requiring qualification.
D03 mistaken-claim recovery remains open before public exclusive-association launch.
D04 following after membership regain and D05 last-follower retention/collection remain separate activation gates.
